_comment: Copy to config/config.json and edit. Only the keys you override matter — anything you omit falls back to jobcut's built-in defaults. Regexes are case-insensitive. NOTHING here is tied to a field: 'filter.include_titles' is left empty on purpose — it's derived from your profile's Target roles when you build your profile (onboarding, Settings → Profile, or the jobcut-profile skill), so it fits whatever job you're after (designer, PM, nurse, analyst…). The 'routing' values are an EXAMPLE geography — set your own.
